statement: SELECT t.entity_id, round(t.f1,3) tf1, round(t.f2,3) tf2, round(t.f3,4) tf3, round(s.f3,4) sf3, round(s.f3-t.f3,4) diff, round(s.f3/t.f3,4) ratio, round(t.f1+t.f2,4) f1plusf2 FROM workspace.mlpabcc3ffa.training_sample t JOIN workspace.mlpabcc3ffa.serving_log s ON t.entity_id=s.entity_id ORDER BY t.entity_id LIMIT 12
